baseline: Exact validation compares the normalized model stdout and declared expected value byte-for-byte.
operator: replace exact equality with surrounding-whitespace trim on both operands
mutation: normalize exact values with trim before comparing
expected_kill: The semantic oracle requires this row to fail; the mutant accepts it.
claim: inf: permissive trimming changes exact validation into a false accept.

operator: case-fold both exact operands before equality
expected_kill: The semantic oracle requires this row to fail; the mutant accepts it.
claim: inf: case-folding erases a manifest-declared exact distinction.

baseline: Regex validation requires the normalized stdout to match the declared pattern as a complete value.
operator: replace full match with substring search
mutation: accept when the pattern matches any stdout substring
expected_kill: The semantic oracle requires this row to fail; the mutant accepts the embedded match.
claim: inf: substring search weakens whole-output regex validation.

baseline: Regex validation uses only manifest-declared flags.
expected_kill: The semantic oracle requires this row to fail when no case-insensitive flag is declared; the mutant accepts it.
claim: inf: an implicit regex flag changes manifest semantics.

baseline: JSON validation parses one complete JSON value and compares structural values, independent of object member order.
operator: replace structural equality with serialized-text equality
mutation: compare raw JSON strings after syntax validation
expected_kill: The semantic oracle requires this row to pass; the mutant rejects equivalent object order.
claim: inf: textual comparison creates a false reject for structurally equal JSON.

baseline: JSON structural equality preserves JSON types.
operator: coerce scalar values to strings before comparison
mutation: treat JSON number, boolean, null, and string spellings as interchangeable text
expected_kill: The semantic oracle requires this row to fail; the mutant accepts a type mismatch.
claim: inf: scalar coercion destroys JSON type fidelity.

baseline: The emitted prompt-ID multiset equals the IDs selected from the requested split.
operator: derive the expected ID set from emitted rows
mutation: compare emitted IDs with a set reconstructed from those same emitted rows
expected_kill: The no-drop oracle requires suite failure for missing hold-2; the mutant self-validates the reduced output.
claim: inf: self-derived expectations make a dropped selected case invisible.

baseline: No-drop validation compares selected and emitted prompt-ID multisets, not counts alone.
operator: replace ID-multiset equality with row-count equality
mutation: accept whenever emitted row count equals selected case count
expected_kill: The no-drop oracle requires suite failure for duplicate cal-1 and missing cal-2; the mutant accepts equal counts.
claim: inf: count-only checking cannot detect substitution or duplication.

baseline: Every selected case emits exactly one result row, including semantic failures.
operator: filter semantic failures before JSONL emission
mutation: emit only rows whose validator result is pass
expected_kill: The row-preservation oracle requires a failing regex-fail row; the mutant drops it.
claim: inf: pass-only output converts semantic failure into missing evidence.

baseline: Runner and validator errors are materialized as failing rows rather than aborting the row pipeline.
operator: return early on normalization or validator error
mutation: abort the case before build_record when JSON parsing or regex compilation fails
expected_kill: The row-preservation oracle requires one failing bad-regex row and continued emission of after-error; the mutant loses one or both rows.
claim: inf: early return makes validator errors disappear and can truncate later rows.

baseline: Each result binds the canonical pre-execution path of the runner actually invoked.
operator: record the configured lexical RUNNER value without canonical resolution
mutation: persist RUNNER exactly as supplied, even when it is a symlink
expected_kill: The provenance oracle requires resolved_runner and invoked_runner to identify runner-v2; the mutant records only the ambiguous symlink path.
claim: inf: lexical-path provenance cannot bind an execution across symlink retargeting.

baseline: Each result binds a pre-execution SHA-256 digest of the runner actually invoked.
operator: hash the default runner instead of the selected runner
mutation: compute runner_sha256 from REPO_ROOT/run.sh regardless of RUNNER override
expected_kill: The provenance oracle recomputes the selected runner digest and rejects the default-runner digest.
claim: inf: hashing a non-invoked default falsely attributes custom-runner results.
